name: SSH agent
description: Makes an SSH agent available to every process in the devcontainer (SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/ssh-agent/agent.sock, also for `devcontainer exec`) so git commits can be signed with an SSH key: the devcontainer-cli launcher bind-mounts the host's agent socket onto that path where the host type has one (linux, macos, a WSL distro), the private key never entering the container; a post-start hook (ssh-agent-setup) checks it on every start and says plainly what a host type without one can do; the opt-in keyMode starts an agent inside the container and loads keys from its own volume instead, which breaks the no-key rule for whoever turns it on. Plus the Feature Taskfile (check, keys, key tasks including key:rotate, key:retire and key:age, git:signing, git:verify).

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

passphraseTimeout.description: Key mode: seconds `task ssh-agent:setup` (and the key tasks) wait for the passphrase of a protected key typed at ssh-add's own prompt. On the timeout, with no terminal to ask on, or with 0 (never prompt), they print one warning (the key is not loaded; task ssh-agent:setup loads it later) and go on with exit 0. The start hook itself never asks: it skips a protected key with that warning. Override per container with SSH_AGENT_SETUP_PASSPHRASE_TIMEOUT in containerEnv.

keyMode.description: Opt-in, temporary: when no host agent socket is forwarded, start an ssh-agent inside the container on the fixed socket and load the private keys found in the ssh-agent-key volume. This puts a private key in the container, which breaks the default rule that the key never enters it; use it only where the host type cannot forward its agent (windows-docker, windows-wslc). Override per container with SSH_AGENT_SETUP_KEY_MODE in containerEnv, or per start with SSH_AGENT_MODE=key on the launcher.
